report: Revision Kohn-Sham theory (SPEC sections 1, 7): exact derivation and checks in WolframScript
coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times; x8 = the hidden direction (y = ln(sin 6Hx8)/(6H) <= 0)

checks.name: fixture_input
checks.detail: gammas read from Revision/algebra/gammas.json (sha256 95d8cbdd0682fd30988b4a21fabc2c6b286a1a35c2f9c02c9d91f56bf5b1fd01)

checks.name: clifford_relation
checks.detail: {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab, eta = diag(+1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1,-1,+1) in x1..x8

checks.name: C_B_Gamma
checks.detail: C = g8 g1 g2 g3 (real symmetric, C^2 = 1), B = -i C g4 (Hermitian, B^2 = 1), Gamma = diag(-I8, I8); BC = -i g4, C g4 = i B, C B C = B

checks.name: geometry_hidden_coordinate
checks.detail: y = Log[Sin[z]]/(6H), z = 6 H x8: dy = Cot[z] dx8, Cot[z]^2 dx8^2 = dy^2, Sin[z]^(1/3) = E^(2 H y); z in (0, Pi/2) <-> y in (-Infinity, 0)

checks.name: geometry_sqrt_det
checks.detail: |det g| = Cos[z]^2 in the author's chart (a4-independent); y chart: Sqrt|g| = W^6 = E^(6 H y)

checks.name: spin_connection_compatibility
checks.detail: canonical spin connection (vielbein postulate), a4 = a4[x4]: nabla_mu gamma^nu = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu)

checks.name: spin_connection_slash_3H
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) exactly, no a4'[x4] term

checks.name: spin_connection_time_terms_cancel
checks.detail: coefficients {(3*Derivative[1][a4][x4])/2, (-3*Derivative[1][a4][x4])/2}; time-direction pieces: sum over the 3 inflating directions = +(3/2) a4' gamma^(x4), over the 3 deflating ones = -(3/2) a4' gamma^(x4): they cancel; Omega_x4 = Omega_y = 0

checks.name: spin_connection_slash_3H_x8_chart
checks.detail: in the author's x8 chart: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^(x8) as well

checks.name: ansatz_removes_spin_connection
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu (e^{ik.x} W^-3 chi(y, x4)) = e^{ik.x} W^-3 [g8 d_y + g4 d_x4 + i kappa k.gamma] chi, kappa = E^(-H y - a4[x4]): exact for time-dependent a4

checks.name: ansatz_without_W3_term_survives
checks.detail: without W^-3 the term 3 H gamma^(x8) chi survives

checks.name: hamiltonian_16_hermitian
checks.detail: i d_x4 chi = h chi with h = i g4 g8 d_y - kappa k_j g4 g^j + M(-i g4) + v: g4 g8 real symmetric, g4 g^j and -i g4 Hermitian

checks.name: blocks_commuting_set
checks.detail: J = g8 g1 g4, K1 = g2 g3, K2 = g5 g6 commute with each other and with g8, g8 g1, g8 g4, B, C

checks.name: blocks_basis_unitary
checks.detail: V = U/(2 Sqrt[2]) unitary, U entries in {0, +-1, +-I}; seeds (0-based) {4, 0, 0, 4, 0, 4, 4, 0}

checks.name: blocks_forms
checks.detail: block (j,s2,s3): g8 = sigma3, g8 g1 = -i sigma2, g8 g4 = j sigma1, B = j s2, C = s2 sigma2, BC = j sigma2, g4 g1 = -j sigma3, B g8 = j s2 sigma3, J = j, K1 = i s2, K2 = i s3

checks.name: blocks_relation_to_Gamma
checks.detail: Gamma anticommutes with J, commutes with K1, K2: block (j,s2,s3) <-> (-j,s2,s3) with 2x2 entry s2 sigma2

checks.name: block_hamiltonian
checks.detail: h_j = j[-i sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v in every block of type j (k along x1)

checks.name: block_ode_equivalent
checks.detail: h_j chi = eps chi <=> chi' = N chi, N = M sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v) sigma1

checks.name: block_type_relation
checks.detail: h_{-1} - v = -(h_{+1} - v); sigma3 h_j(k) sigma3 = h_{-j}(-k) (also for the derivative term): chi_{-j,-k} = sigma3 chi_{j,k}

checks.name: block_Gamma_map
checks.detail: sigma2 h_j(M, k) sigma2 = h_{-j}(-M, k): the block form of Gamma maps (j, M) -> (-j, -M) at the same k, eps; it swaps the brane parities chi2(0) = 0 <-> chi1(0) = 0

checks.name: rotation_invariance
checks.detail: the spinor rotation Cos[th/2] + Sin[th/2] g1 g2 commutes with g8, g4, B, C and rotates k.gamma: spectra depend on |k|

checks.name: gas_mode_projector
checks.detail: flat good-sector modes: h_p^2 = (M^2 + p^2) 1, eps = +-E each 8-fold; G_p = (1 + h_p/E)/2

checks.name: gas_angular_average
checks.detail: explicit S^2 average of the 8-mode one-body matrix G_p B: (B + (M/E) C)/2 (linear terms vanish; only p -> -p symmetry used)

checks.name: gas_densities
checks.detail: rho = sum_occ f u u^dagger B: n = Tr(B rho), S = Tr(C rho); any p -> -p symmetric occupation (any T) gives rho = (nB + SC)/16

checks.name: exchange_uniform_gas
checks.detail: Hartree-Fock: <:S^2:> = (Tr C rho)^2 - Tr(C rho C rho); e_x = -(lambda/2) Tr(C rho C rho) = -1/32*(lam*(nn^2 + SS^2)) (exact, every temperature)

checks.name: ks_potentials
checks.detail: e_int = (15/32) lambda S^2 - (1/32) lambda n^2; M_eff = m + (15/16) lambda S; v_v = -lambda n/16

checks.name: ks_onshell_lagrangian
checks.detail: on shell <L>/sqrt|g| = M_eff S + v_v n - m S - e_int = e_int

checks.name: exchange_slab_exact_fock
checks.detail: closed-shell level (4 blocks of type +1 with D, 4 of type -1 with sigma3 D sigma3), averaged over the 48-element spinor octahedral group (End(16) carries spin 0 and 1 only, so this equals the full SO(3) average): n = 8 d0, S = 8 d2, Q = <Psi^dag B g8 Psi> = 8 d3; exact local Fock exchange -(lambda/32)(n^2 + S^2 - Q^2 - Y^2), Y = 8 d1 (y-current, 0 for eigen-orbitals)

checks.name: bc_mirror_map_PA
checks.detail: P_A: chi(y) -> sigma3 chi(-y) maps (M(y), v(y), kappa(y)) to (-M(-y), v(-y), kappa(-y)); with the mirror warp W = E^(-H|y|) P_A is a symmetry iff M_eff is odd

checks.name: bc_mirror_parities_of_densities
checks.detail: under P_A: n, Q even; S, y-current odd => the mirror carries (-m, +lambda) (v_v even)

checks.name: bc_brane_parity_conditions
checks.detail: ASSUMED Z2 mirror: (1 -+ gamma^(x8)) chi(0) = 0, i.e. chi2(0) = 0 (even) or chi1(0) = 0 (odd); both kill the y-current

checks.name: bc_self_adjoint_boundary_term
checks.detail: phi^dag h_j chi - (h_j phi)^dag chi = d/dy[-i j phi^dag sigma1 chi]: h_j self-adjoint with current-killing ends

checks.name: bc_tip_family
checks.detail: tip: (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q = Cos[theta] sigma3 + Sin[theta] sigma2, Q^2 = 1, {Q, sigma1} = 0; canonical theta = 0: chi2(-L) = 0

checks.name: bc_current_conserved_along_y
checks.detail: chi^dag sigma1 chi is constant in y on solutions (zero for eigen-orbitals)

checks.name: bc_exact_k0_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M, v = 0, theta = 0: even parity: zero mode chi = (E^(M y), 0) and eps = +-Sqrt[M^2 + (n Pi/L)^2]; odd parity: eps^2 = M^2 + p^2 with Tan[p L] = -p/M

checks.name: bc_tip_asymptotics
checks.detail: as y -> -Infinity N -> -kappa k sigma2: branches exp(+- k kappa/H) on the sigma2 = -+1 eigenvectors; for k != 0 the orbital is suppressed at the tip like exp(-|k|(kappa(-L) - kappa(y))/H)

checks.name: rescaling_identity
checks.detail: KS(a4,0; Delta k, v_t, lambda) = KS(0; Delta k E^(-a4,0), v_t E^(-3 a4,0), lambda) exactly (same proper boxes); equivalently KS(0; Delta k E^(-a4,0), v_t, lambda E^(3 a4,0)) with proper densities times E^(-3 a4,0)

checks.name: emt_orbital_components
checks.detail: per orbital (expectation rule, a4 = a4[x4] general, spin connection drops out of the diagonal): -K^x1_x1 = P kappa k chi^dag j sigma3 chi, K^x4_x4 = P eps |chi|^2, K^x2_x2 = K^x5_x5 = 0, -K^y_y = P[(eps - v)|chi|^2 - M chi^dag j sigma2 chi - kappa k chi^dag j sigma3 chi], K_x4y = P (eps - v/2) chi^dag j sigma1 chi (= 0 for eigen-orbitals), P = E^(-6 H y)/(ell^3 v_t); block 0: all residuals 0; block 5: all residuals 0

checks.name: emt_trace_identity
checks.detail: sum of the diagonal K = M_eff s + v_v n (on-shell trace); T^mu_nu = -<K^mu_nu> + delta^mu_nu e_int

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_orbital
checks.detail: one orbital (j = 1) in external M(y), v(y): d/dy[(eps - v) n_c - M s_c - kappa k t_c] = H kappa k t_c - v' n_c - M' s_c

checks.name: emt_y_conservation_selfconsistent
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_y = p8' + 6H p8 - 3H(p3 + p_t); the force terms of the orbital identity cancel against e_int' for the self-consistent M_eff, v_v

checks.name: emt_x4_component
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d_x4 rho - 3 a4' (p3 - p_t) for diagonal T: dE/dx4 = -3 a4' Integral sqrt|g| (p3 - p_t)

checks.name: adiabatic_hellmann_feynman
checks.detail: d_a h_j = -j kappa k sigma3 = -k d_k h_j; eps(k, a) = eps(k E^(-a), 0): d eps/da = -k d eps/dk (frozen potentials)

checks.name: adiabatic_offdiagonal_identity
checks.detail: <n| d_a h |m> = (eps_m - eps_n) <n| d_a m> (explicit family); Q_nm = A H |<n| d_a h_KS |m>|/(eps_n - eps_m)^2

checks.name: ks_theory_json_written
checks.detail: ks-theory.json written deterministically (two exports identical, LF) and re-imported: basis and coefficients round-trip
